products.name: Gym Challenge Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs of the Unlimited print. TCGplayer lists the box (285314) with no price at all, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: Theme Deck "Blaine"
products.note: A 60-card Gym Challenge theme deck, featuring Blaine's Arcanine (Gym Challenge 1); holographic Alakazam coin. Not simulated: coin and markers. List: Bulbapedia deck page and PokeBeach's Gym Challenge theme-deck page (they differ by a card in places).
products.priceSource: No TCGplayer price for the sealed deck: the sum of its 60 cards at the site's card prices (TCGplayer market, Unlimited). A sealed deck sells for more.
